name: Theriothron Spire
detailed_description:
This is Duan Shuang, an indie developer. I hope you enjoy my work.

Theriothron Spire: Embark on a dark journey where redemption intertwines with downfall.​​

A silent protagonist. A single goal: Ascend the dreaded ​Theriothron Spire​ to rescue your sister from a mysterious sacrificial ritual. But the Spire is no mere physical challenge – it is a twisted prison, each floor confining bizarre and malevolent "Beasts." These creatures stand as guards, yet are also intrinsic components of this distorted world.

​The Weight of Choice: Moral Quandaries & Branching Narrative​

Within the Theriothron Spire, morality exists not in simple black and white. To progress, to seek clues, even to survive, you will be forced into agonizing ethical dilemmas: Slaughter the Beasts blocking your path? Or risk attempting to save those who still possess reason or deserve compassion? Every decision sends ripples through the Spire, altering the characters you encounter, the aid you receive, and ultimately steering you towards multiple, divergent endings. The story delves into profound philosophical discussions, where characters might even break the fourth wall, addressing you—the player beyond the screen. Your choices shape not only the protagonist's fate, but also demand soul-searching from you.

​Classic Strategic Combat: Easy to Learn, Mastered by Calculation​

The battle system is built upon the classic Magic Tower framework, emphasizing strategy and resource management. Simple and intuitive, yet deeply rewarding:

  • ​Attributes Reign Supreme:​​ Attack (ATK) and Defense (DEF) stats are paramount. Meticulously calculating losses from each encounter is critical.

  • ​Resource Management:​​ Limited keys, potions, and special items require careful planning of both your path and your battle tactics.

  • ​Deliberate Steps:​​ Each move demands forethought – avoiding overwhelming foes or seeking the optimal solution.

​The Hidden Curse: Corruption System​

Early within the Spire, you acquire a mysterious artifact allowing you to skip the majority of combat encounters. While forgoing battle avoids stat loss, the price is steep: forfeiting valuable loot and experience points. This choice profoundly impacts the story's direction and its endings. How will you weigh ruthless efficiency against your humanity?

Are you prepared to ascend the ​Theriothron Spire​? Every choice you make will inscribe the protagonist's story and define your own path through this dark odyssey. Is it a path of redemption, or the first steps toward ruin? ​The answer lies in your hands.​

short_description: A young boy ventures into the twisted Tower of the Beast God to save his sister from sacrificial ritual. This adventure RPG blends deep storytelling with classic tactical combat – your choices will forge the final outcome.
